description: This file defines UI components and formatting logic for displaying information about nodes in a menu within a macOS application using SwiftUI. It includes utilities for rendering node details such as names, roles, platform tags, version labels, and icons, as well as custom views for individual menu entries and multilines.

classes.name: NodeMenuEntryFormatter
classes.description: A utility struct providing static methods to format, categorize, and generate icons and display text for node entries displayed in the menu.

methods.name: isGateway
methods.description: Checks if the node entry is identified as a gateway based on its nodeId.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the node entry is currently connected.

methods.name: primaryName
methods.description: Returns the primary display name for the node, appending 'Gateway' if applicable.

methods.name: summaryText
methods.description: Generates a summarized info string for the node, including host IP, platform, version, and status.

methods.name: roleText
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string indicating the node's connection or pairing status.

methods.name: detailLeft
methods.description: Provides a string with the node's IP address and role.

methods.name: headlineRight
methods.description: Returns platform label info for display on the right side of the node entry.

methods.name: detailRightVersion
methods.description: Returns version labels (core/UI) for detailed display.

methods.name: platformText
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly platform name based on device family or platform string.

methods.name: compactVersion
methods.description: Trims and simplifies version strings for display.

methods.name: shortVersionLabel
methods.description: Returns a shortened version label, adding 'v' prefix if necessary.

methods.name: versionLabels
methods.description: Generates version labels for core and UI versions, optionally compressed.

methods.name: resolveVersions
methods.description: Resolves core and UI version strings, falling back on legacy if necessary.

methods.name: isHeadlessPlatform
methods.description: Identifies if a platform is headless based on platform info.

methods.name: leadingSymbol
methods.description: Determines the icon symbol name for a node, based on its device or role.

methods.name: isAndroid
methods.description: Checks if the node is an Android device.

methods.name: safeSystemSymbol
methods.description: Verifies if a system symbol exists; returns fallback if not.
